lessons.title: Way in, way out
lessons.goal: Read the entry, exit and reception signs at a hospital gate.
grammar: sign words are bare nouns: প্রবেশ 'way in', বাহির 'way out'
formal word ↔ everyday word: ফটক / গেট, প্রবেশ / ঢোকা
lessons.tip:
Signs use **formal words** that you rarely say. You already know their everyday partners:

- **প্রবেশ** 'way in' (you say ঢোকা)
- **ফটক** 'gate' (you say গেট)
- **বাহির** 'way out', the old written form of বাইরে

**Reading the conjuncts:** a small stroke under a letter is **র-ফলা** (ro-fola), an r after it: **প্র** = প + র in **প্রবেশ**, **প্রধান**. A hook on top is **ref**, an r before it: **র্গ** in **বহির্গমন** (bohir-gomon). In **অভ্যর্থনা** the য-ফলা doubles the ভ: *obbhorthona*.

sentences.en: The way in is this way.
The way out is that way.
The emergency department is on the left.

lessons.title: Not allowed
lessons.goal: Read 'no smoking', 'no entry' and 'restricted' signs on office doors.
grammar: X নিষেধ 'no X': ধূমপান নিষেধ, প্রবেশ নিষেধ
ব্যতীত is the written partner of ছাড়া 'without'
lessons.tip:
**X নিষেধ** is 'X is not allowed': **ধূমপান নিষেধ** 'No smoking', **প্রবেশ নিষেধ** 'No entry'. **নিষিদ্ধ** 'prohibited' is the stronger, official word.

**অনুমতি ব্যতীত প্রবেশ নিষেধ** 'No entry without permission'. In speech you would say **অনুমতি ছাড়া ঢোকা মানা**: same meaning, everyday words.

**Spelling:** নিষেধ and নিষিদ্ধ are spelled with **ষ**, though you say *sh*. **ক্ষ** in **সংরক্ষিত** is said *kkh*: *shongrokkhito*. **ব্য** is ব + য-ফলা: **ব্যতীত** *byatito*.

sentences.en: Smoking is prohibited in the office.
You can't go in without permission.

lines.en: Smoking is prohibited in the office

lessons.title: Please, on a sign
lessons.goal: Read polite requests on a mosque or clinic door: take off your shoes, switch off your phone, use the bin.
grammar: written commands in -উন: খুলুন, রাখুন, ফেলুন (speech: খোলেন, রাখেন, ফেলেন)
lessons.tip:
Signs ask politely with **-উন** commands: **খুলুন**, **রাখুন**, **ফেলুন**, **করুন**. In everyday Bangladeshi speech you say **খোলেন**, **রাখেন**, **ফেলেন**. Same meaning, written style.

**অনুগ্রহ করে** is the written 'please' (speech: **দয়া করে**). **স্থান** is the written word for **জায়গা** 'place', and **পরিচ্ছন্ন** for **পরিষ্কার** 'clean'.

**Conjuncts:** **স্থ** = স + থ (**স্থান** *sthan*). **র্দ** has a ref on দ and **ষ্ট** is ষ + ট: **নির্দিষ্ট** *nirdishto*. **চ্ছ** is চ + ছ: **পরিচ্ছন্ন**.

lessons.title: Caution
lessons.goal: Read danger and caution signs at a substation and a building site.
grammar: X করবেন না 'do not X' on signs: স্পর্শ করবেন না
থাকুন 'please stay / be': দূরে থাকুন, সতর্ক থাকুন
lessons.tip:
Warning signs start with a heading: **বিপদ!** 'Danger!' or **সাবধান!** 'Caution!'. Then comes the instruction: **স্পর্শ করবেন না** 'do not touch' (speech: ধরবেন না), **দূরে থাকুন** 'keep away'.

**অগ্নি** is the formal word for **আগুন** 'fire'; you meet it in **অগ্নি নিরাপত্তা** 'fire safety'.

**Conjuncts:** **জ্জ** is a held j (**বিপজ্জনক** *bipojjonok*); **দ্য** doubles the d (**বৈদ্যুতিক** *boiddutik*); **ত্ত** is a held t (**নিরাপত্তা**). **স্প** = স + প, and **র্শ** has a ref: **স্পর্শ** *sporsho*.

sentences.en: This area is dangerous; keep away.
Do not touch the electric line.

questions.question: What must you not do near the electric line?

lessons.title: Open, closed, changed
lessons.goal: Read office hours, closing days and 'cancelled / postponed' notes.
grammar: times in words: সকাল দশটা থেকে বিকাল পাঁচটা পর্যন্ত
lessons.tip:
An hours board: **সময়সূচি** 'opening hours', **সাপ্তাহিক ছুটি** 'weekly day off', **সরকারি ছুটি** 'public holiday'. Times are written in words here: **সকাল দশটা থেকে বিকাল পাঁচটা পর্যন্ত**.

Two words for 'not today': **স্থগিত** 'postponed' (it will happen later) and **বাতিল** 'cancelled' (it will not happen).

The road-works line **সাময়িক অসুবিধার জন্য দুঃখিত** is 'Sorry for the temporary inconvenience'.

**Spelling:** **সময়সূচি** ends in short **ি** (Academy spelling); you will also see সময়সূচী. **প্ত** in **সাপ্তাহিক** is প + ত.

lessons.title: The notice board
lessons.goal: Read a building notice (বিজ্ঞপ্তি) and a to-let card, and recognise the sadhu হইবে.
grammar: notice formula: সর্বসাধারণের অবগতির জন্য জানানো যাচ্ছে যে …
lessons.tip:
A **বিজ্ঞপ্তি** 'notice' opens with a fixed formula: **সর্বসাধারণের অবগতির জন্য জানানো যাচ্ছে যে …** 'This is to inform the public that …'. It ends with the sender: **আদেশক্রমে, কর্তৃপক্ষ** 'By order, the management'. **উক্ত** 'the said' points back: **উক্ত সময়ে** 'during that time'.

**Sadhu:** old to-let cards say **বাড়ি ভাড়া দেওয়া হইবে**. **হইবে** is the sadhu (old written) form of **হবে**. Recognise it; never say it.

**Conjuncts:** **জ্ঞ** is said *gg*: **বিজ্ঞপ্তি** *biggopti*. **কর্তৃপক্ষ** has a ref (র্ত), the ri-sign ৃ and ক্ষ: *kortripokkho*.

sentences.en: Have you seen the new notice?

sentences.bn: সর্বসাধারণের অবগতির জন্য জানানো যাচ্ছে যে আগামী শুক্রবার লিফট বন্ধ থাকবে।
sentences.tr: shorboshadharoner obogotir jonno janano jachchhe je agami shukrobar lift bondho thakbe.
sentences.en: This is to inform the public that the lift will be out of service next Friday.
Please use the stairs during that time.

lessons.title: Counters and services
lessons.goal: Find your way in a bank branch and a station: customer service, queues, toilets and reserved seats.
grammar: formal ↔ everyday: প্রয়োজন / দরকার, কার্যালয় / অফিস, শৌচাগার / বাথরুম, সারিতে / লাইনে
lessons.tip:
Counters and services have formal names. Each has an everyday partner you already say:

- **প্রয়োজন** = দরকার 'need'
- **কার্যালয়** = অফিস 'office'
- **শৌচাগার** = বাথরুম, টয়লেট 'toilet'
- **সারিতে** = লাইনে 'in the queue'

**গ্রাহক সেবা** is 'customer service' and **সংরক্ষিত আসন** is a 'reserved seat'.

**Conjuncts:** **গ্র** is গ + র-ফলা (**গ্রাহক** *grahok*). **র্য** is a ref on য (**কার্যালয়** *karjaloy*). In **শৌচাগার** the ৌ sign wraps the শ: *shou*.

lessons.title: Review: read it again
lessons.goal: Reread the notice and two sign sets, three times each, and recall every R1 word.
grammar: repeated reading: the same text three times, a little faster each time
lessons.tip:
**Read it again.** Each text in this review comes back three times. Read it aloud with the audio first, then on your own, then silently and faster. Repeated reading is the quickest way to build reading speed.

Keep the pairs in mind: on signs, **প্রবেশ** (ঢোকা), **ব্যতীত** (ছাড়া), **স্থান** (জায়গা), **প্রয়োজন** (দরকার), **হইবে** (হবে).

lessons.title: Checkpoint: Signs and notices
lessons.goal: Read an unseen station notice and scan six signs. Pass: at least 80% right.
lessons.tip: **Checkpoint.** A notice you have not seen before, and six signs to scan. Read the notice once, at your normal speed, then answer. Try to find each sign's meaning in under five seconds.
